title: Halloween Monster Egg
description: A review activity for grades 1–6. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Log in with an active Premium account.
Choose two or three teams and type their names.
Set the rounds, timer, background, and audio.
Open Question Editor to add or change questions.
Click START GAME and follow the instructions.
Students tap answers to earn gold.
At the end, check the scores from both rounds.
